searchText: Hi guys, we're trying to deploy some test validators on Prater via smart contracts and it looks like the Beacon Chain hasn't picked them up yet - we can see the event emitted in the deposit contract on Goerli, and it looks like Prater's Eth 1 data has moved onto blocks beyond our deposits, but the validators aren't showing up in our Beacon clients yet https://prater.beaconcha.in/validators/eth1deposits is showing that all of the new validators on the chain, starting with our first one, aren't being activated I just want to make sure we didn't break the testnet with our deposits... <@!340345049063882753> <@!553610810652622860> Do either of you have any insight? Here's the goerli TX for the first deposit: <https://goerli.etherscan.io/tx/0x52ebacc54b666a868bdb2222c6a24a2f5e893adbdbbbfac77ac1133032cab7a9> Probably not great to ping random people, just give it a bit more time for people to get back to you. In this case Prater has currently voted in block 0x0d7fd7ad4f2c6de242ecd4e82ee3f406b815009c6785507788598463c0179b0b which is 5206344 and the first unconfirmed validator deposited in block 5212284 so the deposit hasn't yet been included. I think it's on track to be included in the next voting period but I may have misread the details on that. My apologies, I was advised to ask you about it Prater currently has a drop in participation and is at 70% which might be why your deposits arent being voted in Ok, I'm not in a rush - I just wanted to make sure we didn't break anything Each voting period seems to be reaching 50%. The bit I'm not sure about is if they're voting for significantly old blocks or something like that in those voting periods. Maybe some prysm nodes on Prater that didn't update for Goerli London support? (their Go bindings had to change) afaik, all of our nodes are running our current release, which has the updated london bindings participation is still at 70%, which might be an issue here I am happy to report that it is working now, we have validators up with 0x01 withdrawal credentials 👍 Just took ~28 hours for the deposit to process and the validators to get activated
